purpose: Execute the unchanged three-cell screen after preserving the measured coherent true/one source FLIP roster instead of reassigning true and triggering Blender's toggle-style particle-system callback.

authority.scope: Three fresh local-only seven-frame Data bakes at Preview/Review resolution; zero Mesh bake, save, render, network or engine remote write; ordinary research commit and non-force push are allowed.

correction.sourceCallbackFinding: Assigning use_flip_particles invokes rna_Fluid_flip_parts_update. When a FLIP system already exists, the callback deletes it and clears the particle-type bit; an unchanged-looking true assignment is therefore not idempotent.
correction.changedBehavior: Require the exact true/one roster and preserve it without assigning use_flip_particles before the unchanged Data bake.

interpretationTable.condition: preview baseline has outliers and preview +1-cell effector has zero
preview baseline and review baseline outlier counts differ without the surface-distance condition above
interpretationTable.nextCell: review-effector-plus1 when Review has outliers; otherwise final-resolution-baseline-reproduction

interpretationTable.condition: all three cells have zero one-cell-envelope outliers

interpretationTable.nextCell: cup topology, normals, Is Planar and applied-transform audit

stopRule: Stop on non-fresh roots, retained failure drift, dirty research worktree, input drift, any initial roster other than exact true/one, source geometry or placement drift, cell/configuration mismatch, missing evaluated particles, aggregate/detail mismatch, cache roster other than exact 14 config/Data files per cell, process/log/result failure, any Mesh bake/save/render/network/remote-write count, symlink, banned media or resource failure. Do not assign use_flip_particles, enable Delete in Obstacle, vary CFL/timesteps or proceed to slow tip in this attempt.
claimCeiling: One C2-corrected three-cell Data-only Preview/Review screen for obstacle-level-set and resolution signals in the static cup. It can select the next diagnostic cell only; it does not prove a Final-resolution correction, reconstructed-surface quality, slow tip, impact, render or finished-film quality.
